scenarios.title: A creature with bushido gets +N/+N when it blocks

setup.notes: Jade Avenger is a 2/2 with bushido 2.

decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against B.
B declares Jade Avenger as a blocker of Grizzly Bears.
Bushido triggers; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: blocks
variants.expected: Bushido triggers when Jade Avenger blocks and it becomes a 4/4 until end of turn. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Jade Avenger, which survives with 2 damage marked. Jade Avenger deals 4 damage to Grizzly Bears, which moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: no_block
variants.expected: Bushido does not trigger and Jade Avenger stays a 2/2. Grizzly Bears is unblocked and deals 2 damage to B, whose life total is 18.

scenarios.title: A creature with bushido gets +N/+N when it becomes blocked

setup.notes: Jade Avenger is a 2/2 with bushido 2.

decisions: A declares Jade Avenger as an attacker against B.
B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Jade Avenger.
Bushido triggers; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: becomes_blocked
variants.expected: Bushido triggers when Jade Avenger becomes blocked and it becomes a 4/4 until end of turn. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Jade Avenger, which survives with 2 damage marked. Jade Avenger deals 4 damage to Grizzly Bears, which moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Bushido does not trigger and Jade Avenger stays a 2/2. Jade Avenger is unblocked and deals 2 damage to B, whose life total is 18.

scenarios.title: Each instance of bushido triggers separately

setup.notes: Devoted Retainer is a 1/1 with bushido 1. Sensei Golden-Tail's ability gives the target creature a second, permanent instance of bushido 1.

decisions: A activates Sensei Golden-Tail ({1}{W}, {T}) targeting Devoted Retainer, paying with both Plains. Both players pass; the ability resolves.
A declares Devoted Retainer as an attacker against B.
B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Devoted Retainer.
Every bushido trigger that was put on the stack resolves.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Devoted Retainer has two instances of bushido 1 and two bushido triggers resolve, making it a 3/3 until end of turn. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to it and it survives with 2 damage marked. Devoted Retainer deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: A does not activate Sensei Golden-Tail.
variants.expected: Devoted Retainer has one instance of bushido 1 and one trigger resolves, making it a 2/2 until end of turn. The two creatures deal 2 damage to each other and both move to their owners' graveyards.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Neither bushido trigger fires and Devoted Retainer stays a 1/1. It is unblocked and deals 1 damage to B, whose life total is 19.

scenarios.forge_notes: Sensei Golden-Tail's ability is sorcery speed, so it is activated in main phase 1 before attackers are declared.
